description:
Assemble your team of iconic Marvel Heroes and Villains in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, the Ultimate 4v4 Tag-Team Fighter!  

The Champion has set his sights on Earth.   

Build your dream team of legendary Marvel characters, unleash explosive 4v4 tag battles, and rise to his challenge to save the planet.  Fight your way through ranked online matches, challenge friends in local battles, experience five original stories in Episode Mode, explore the Online Lobby, and master a launch roster of 20 iconic Marvel characters. 

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available now! https://epic.gm/marvel-tokon
